Topology.title: Hierarchical Network Architecture
Topology.Description: A secure hierarchical network design for a government entity, including an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connectivity for remote sites.
Topology.Summary: The topology includes an Internet Edge zone with a firewall and application-layer security, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to regional and branch offices. Remote sites have local routing and switching.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' node (n_new1) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z8), which suggests the presence of an asset management system.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation Management Service' node (n_struct3) in the 'Data Flow Documentation' zone (z9), indicating the presence of data flow documentation.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z6) and a 'Data Center' (z2), indicating segmentation of data processing and storage based on sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' node (n1) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), which is a common implementation of a firewall on servers.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' node (n15) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), indicating the presence of a trusted DNS server.

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node (n3) and an 'MFA/Identity Node' (n14) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), suggesting the requirement for MFA for remote network access.

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Node' (n16) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), indicating the use of DNS filtering services.

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' node (n17) and an 'Application Firewall' node (n18) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), suggesting the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (Internet Edge, Data Center, Regional Office, Branch Office, Management Zone, Non-Production Zone, External Testing Zone) and nodes that suggest a secure network architecture with segmentation, least privilege, and availability.

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Tools Management Service' node (n_struct4) in the 'IaC Tools' zone (z10), indicating the use of Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) for managing network infrastructure.

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' node (n13) and an 'MFA/Identity Node' (n14) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), indicating centralized network AAA.

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node (n3) and an 'MFA/Identity Node' (n14) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), suggesting that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Dedicated Admin Workstation' node (n21) in the 'Management Zone' (z5), indicating the presence of dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' node (n11) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (Internet Edge, Data Center, Regional Office, Branch Office, Management Zone, Non-Production Zone, External Testing Zone) and links between them, suggesting traffic filtering between network segments.

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' node (n3) and an 'MFA/Identity Node' (n14) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), suggesting the management of access control for remote assets.

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' node (n12) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' node (n11) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), which can also serve as a network intrusion prevention solution.

Control.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' node (n20) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

Control.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Layer Security Appliance' node (n2) and an 'Application Firewall' node (n18) in the 'Internet Edge' zone (z1), indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z6) and a 'Data Center' (z2), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Node' (n22) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z7), indicating the capability to perform periodic external penetration tests.
